name: Rhubarb Juice

ingredients.name: rhubarb stalks, sliced crosswise into 1-inch pieces

instructions.primary_message: In a large Dutch oven, combine rhubarb and water. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, and reduce heat to simmer for 15 minutes.
Strain liquid through a fine-mesh strainer into a pitcher or spouted bowl, pressing on the solids in strainer to extract as much juice as possible.

Refrigerate until cold, at least 3 hours. If the juice separates, leaving a yellowish sludge at the bottom, decant the clear pink liquid into a clean bottle or pitcher, leaving the sludge behind. Serve cold over ice, adding sugar to taste, if desired.

description: This is one of those deceptively simple recipes, passed down through friends of friends, that everyone adores. Once chilled, the juice is brisk and refreshing, with just a touch of sweetness.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 3 hr 25 min.

Notes: You can line the fine-mesh strainer with cheesecloth to strain out more solids.
author: Carolyn Cope
